doc: stages/filters.expression.rst: 'The **Expression Filter** applies filtering to the input point cloud based on a set of criteria on the given dimensions.' -- ReturnNumber in grid.las is (i % 3) + 1 over i = 0..999, so ReturnNumber == 1 selects the indices divisible by 3: 0, 3, ..., 999, which is 334 points.
